what: Behind the panel, twenty faint light discs (two colors at three : one) float around (WebGL) — each disc fades out via smoothstep from .1 at the center to .75 radius, drifts in its own direction 2px per frame and bounces within ±500px of the panel center, and its size swings between .5 and 5 times by sin(time + offset) × .0095~.01 per step, so the misty gradient slowly shifts

options.speed: Drift distance per frame (px), default 2 — at 0 it just breathes in place
options.wall: Bounce distance (px from the panel center), default 500
options.count: Number of discs, default 20 (every fourth uses the second color)

note: Before loading the three r152 CommonJS build, load ../photo-cylinder-spin/three-global.js and read it as window.THREE. The original renders at window size, not panel size — here it renders at panel size so nothing gets cropped

from.where: list.html·about.html [data-gl=gradient] (original script-common-gradient — gradient circle and good night band inside an 814px round plate)
